changes: Added a standalone HOSTGPU_NATIVE_CONTROL gem5 target registered before the VEGA_X86-gated simulator path, with BUILD_ISA=n, USE_X86_ISA=n, and BUILD_GPU=y.
Reused the existing host protocol, bounded page-memory state, queue state, and signal state in a deterministic control-core self-test without forking the CP8/CP13 wire.
Retained a no-x86/no-production-DSO ELF audit and the direct control-core JSON self-test, with explicit kernel_executed=false, cpu_fallback=false, and vega_x86=false flags.
Re-ran eight existing VEGA_X86 host-state regression binaries and bound the clean child identities to the CP-0015 prepare journal.
limitations: CP-0015 proves a standalone no-VEGA_X86 control-plane/build boundary only. It does not map PT_LOAD ranges, apply relocations, construct dynamic AQL or kernarg, submit a GPU queue, invoke the Vega decoder, or execute simulator instructions.
The ELF audit is scoped to the HOSTGPU_NATIVE_CONTROL target; it is not proof that the full gem5 GPU pipeline is independent of x86 System, Process, ThreadContext, or translation objects.
The eight VEGA_X86 state regressions are compatibility/oracle evidence, not host-native GPU execution evidence.
No Triton, HIP, OpenCL, PyTorch, vLLM, model, hardware, timing, or performance claim is made. Triton end-to-end remains 0/1.

argv: Connect the accepted CP13 loader and runtime protocol to the host-native target and prove pinned gfx950 loader/dispatch parity
next_action.expected: The host-native target consumes the accepted CP13 transport and maps one pinned gfx950 image through the same loader/dispatch metadata as the VEGA_X86 oracle, with deterministic output/trace comparison and no Triton, hardware, timing, or performance claim.
prerequisites: CP-0015 is accepted and scripts/resume.sh --verify passes offline.
The CP-0015 standalone target, no-x86 audit, direct self-test, legacy regressions, and child identities remain immutable.
SOURCE_LOCK.json and PROJECT_LANES.json remain byte-identical to their accepted anchors.
The adapter must consume the existing CP13 fixed-record transport and loader authority, must not fork a second code-object ABI, and must not open production GPU devices.
next_action.rollback_boundary: Keep CP-0015 accepted and preserve the standalone control core, VEGA_X86 oracle, CP13 transport authority, and no-execution boundary if loader or dispatch parity fails.
